meta.name: make-trace
meta.description: Turn any source that describes how a kind of task gets done (a SKILL.md, a chat log, a runbook, plain prose) into a runnable Morph trace. Lift it into a DAG, write a contract per step, place inputs, and drive the full run lifecycle to verify it. Use whenever someone wants to make a trace from a source.

copy.tagline: 将任务描述转化为可运行的自动化流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把操作手册或对话记录变成可执行的自动化步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Turn task descriptions into runnable automation flows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn runbooks or chat logs into executable automation steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能将任何描述任务如何完成的资料（如 SKILL.md、聊天记录、操作手册等）转化为可运行的 Morph trace，包括构建 DAG、为每一步编写合同、放置输入文件，并驱动完整的运行生命周期来验证它。
howto.when: 当用户提供描述任务如何完成的资料，并希望将其转化为可运行的 trace 时触发。

say.text: 请根据这份 SKILL.md 创建一个 trace。
say.note: Claude 会读取资料并生成 trace 文件夹。

say.text: 帮我将这段聊天记录转化为可运行的 trace。
say.note: Claude 会提取步骤并构建 DAG。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can turn any source describing how a task gets done (e.g., SKILL.md, chat log, runbook, plain prose) into a runnable Morph trace: lift it into a DAG, write a contract per step, place inputs, and drive the full run lifecycle to verify it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user provides a source describing how a task gets done and wants to turn it into a runnable trace.

say_en.text: Please create a trace from this SKILL.md.
say_en.note: Claude reads the source and generates a trace folder.

say_en.text: Turn this chat log into a runnable trace.
say_en.note: Claude extracts steps and builds a DAG.
